source.title: Proposal: Field mode — offline visit & cupping log (SCA CVA-style) linked to suppliers

source.body:
**Decision needed:** approve an offline-first field log for farm visits and cuppings. **Recommendation: approve, built after the Sourcing CRM (it attaches to CRM records).** It has to be done before Jan 4.

## Problem / opportunity
On the trip you'll be on farms with poor or no signal during peak harvest. Existing cupping apps (for example Catador CVA, iOS, $4.99/month for unlimited) score well but don't know the supplier, lot, price or visit. Only an old training app claims offline use. A cupping tied to a supplier and an offer price is the join nobody offers.

## Proposed feature (what Z will see and be able to do)
- A **Field** view on your phone. Start a visit (organisation, date, location from GPS if allowed, notes, altitude, varieties, process, harvest status, price talked about).
- **Cupping sheets**: a flight with N samples, scored on a simplified SCA CVA-style form (attribute sliders, defects and notes, total). Each sample links to a CRM sample.
- **Works with no signal**: entries save on the phone and sync to the server automatically when you're back online, with a visible "3 entries waiting to sync" badge.
- Installable to the home screen (PWA).

## Approach (files touched, data sources + their terms, new dependencies)
- `app/static/sw.js` + `manifest.webmanifest` (new): service worker caching the app shell; IndexedDB outbox for writes.
- `app/main.py` / `app/store.py`: `/api/field/visits`, `/api/field/cuppings`, with idempotent client-generated IDs so retries never duplicate.
- `app/static/app.js`: Field view. Tests for idempotent upserts and score totals.
- No new server dependencies; vanilla JS, no build step.
- I'll implement our own simplified form rather than copying SCA's scoresheet layout verbatim, and link to SCA's CVA docs.
- Rejected alternative: a native app. It needs app stores and a build pipeline, which is overkill for the trip.

## Out of scope
Photos (v2: they need storage decisions), multi-user cupping sessions, Q-grade calibration.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] With the network off (DevTools offline), you can create a visit and a 4-sample cupping, reload, and see them; they sync when back online with no duplicates
- [ ] Each cupping can be linked to a CRM organisation and sample
- [ ] Usable one-handed at 375 px
- [ ] ruff + pytest pass; demo-mode curl smoke test

## Size: M (2–3 runs). Depends on the Sourcing CRM proposal. Also needs hosting before the trip (I'll research free hosting next and propose it separately).

## Research behind it
[agent/research/2026-10-15-competitor-landscape.md](https://github.com/zack-hum/coffee-intelligence-v1.1/blob/docs/research-2026-10-15/agent/research/2026-10-15-competitor-landscape.md)

**How we'll know it worked:** every farm visit and cupping on the trip is logged here, including ones captured with no signal.
